plan.title: Prevent Technical Templates in RFQ Dropdown

steps.note: Open the multi-stage RFX creation flow.
Provide the required event title so the create flow is valid.
Create the Technical and Commercial RFQ stages required by the scenario.
Configure the technical stage before checking template separation.
Apply a technical-stage template so the RFQ stage can be checked against it.
Navigate to the commercial RFQ stage settings.
Inspect the RFQ template dropdown and assert that the known technical template is not offered.
